title: Single-degree left-edge comparison before coefficient identification
statement: For a Grothendieck abelian B and C with derived categories and an additive left exact functor G, the canonical lift of G of the cycle inclusion of the single complex A[n], followed by homology projection and the hypercohomology left edge, equals G applied to the homology projection of A[n].

proof.text: Extend the single complex by zero and compute the truncation spectral object edge via the derived unit; the cycle and homology comparison maps are the canonical maps for the single complex.

proof_origin.note: Intermediate statement isolating the single-complex edge calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge_single_aux (A : B) (n : ℕ) :
    let S := (HomologicalComplex.single B (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n).obj A
    let T := (G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj S
    let a := T.liftCycles (G.map (S.iCycles n)) (n + 1) (by simp) (by
      change G.map (S.iCycles n) ≫ G.map (S.d n (n + 1)) = 0
      rw [← G.map_comp, S.iCycles_d, G.map_zero])
    a ≫ T.homologyπ n ≫ G.cochainHypercohomologyLeftEdge S n =
      G.map (S.homologyπ n)
